sentences.en: Unequal access to quality education perpetuates this uneven income distribution.
sentences.zh: 1. 质量教育机会的不平等分配会加剧收入分配的不均。

sentences.en: Lonely people perpetuate their own loneliness through their fear of others.
sentences.zh: 2. 孤独的人因害怕他人而持续保持自己的孤独状态。

sentences.en: Every nation seeks to perpetuate itself.
sentences.zh: 3. 每个国家都力求永续发展。
